title: Last Son of Eve - Tower - Tower - LSOE

lines.l: In this wasteland, where skies are never silent, we were brought up with a rumble in the ground.
But we were dreamers
We were turned to bed
Watch all these cities
Build on imagination
By our sweat and blood frustration
Transcending in what we are
Cause we are dreamers
We are tentative built
Searching for answers
So let us build a tower
A way to get to you
Yes, we're sorting out our plans
Even now we're born again
It feels like nothing's new under the sun
So let us build a tower
A way to get to you
To let us fill the tower
I'll wait again to you
Yeah
As we learn to speak the word
Still not convinced that we'll be hurt
I'm gone
I feel the past is hounding me
Although I know that I am free
Don't you see I'm still digging in the dirt
Cause we don't let the stone unturned
As we're digging in the dirt
We just want to know the truth
Or we will get to
